definitions.explanation: The natural features of an area viewed as a whole.

examples.japanese: {景色|けしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だ。

examples.english: I can see the ocean view from the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{景色|けしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だった。
examples.english: The scenery from the mountain was beautiful.
In autumn the mountain scenery is beautiful, so many people go on trips.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{景色|けしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: I like enjoying the scenery from the train window, so I always sit near the window.

notes:
{景色|けしき} refers to the visual appearance of a place, especially natural scenery viewed as a whole.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {景色|けしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: the scenery is nice
- {景色|けしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy the scenery
- {景色|けしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: the scenery changes
- ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{景色|けしき}: beautiful scenery

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {景色|けしき}: scenery, landscape (everyday word)
- ⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧: scenery (more formal/literary, used in art)
- ⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧: view (from a specific vantage point)
- ⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧: scene, sight (often dramatic or memorable)
